hook: An Esoteric-class doomsday file about a glowing tree-and-insect entity in the Mojave whose fluid remakes living things, and which already affects around 6% of the world's population. The exposure table is the most memorable part, and one of its entries ends in a violent breach with dozens of casualties.
whyItMatters: It is written from inside a containment failure: the procedures are titled Strategic Conduct Protocols, open by admitting full containment is not possible, and describe a demilitarized zone held jointly with rival organizations. Tagged as part of Apotheosis, it treats the anomaly as a social change already underway rather than an object in a cell. Infected humans keep their personalities and memories, and the article lists what they are doing with their new powers, from murder to wiping out diseases.
thingsToNotice: The exposure table grows with each row: a bearded dragon becomes a 25 m spore-venting giant with fungal genetics, and a dog sheds its fur, sprouts horns and heals through vivisection. Then a woman says she understands firepower, conjures rotary cannons, and escapes while her body bursts into exploding fragments that turn into more guns, leaving 37 casualties. The last subject splits into five, all of whom declare that only fools would call magic's blessing a curse, fuse into a ten-armed mass circled by floating eye-palmed hands, and vanish behind a whirl of seawater. Thaumic scanners return only the word THRIVE, in a random language each time, and the file closes on Contingency ALABASTER and a promise to protect what humanity remains.
